hypothesis: If the Launch App CTA button or hero navigation reads user-supplied query parameters (e.g. ?redirect= or ?next=) and passes them to router.push or window.location without enforcing exact relative same-origin paths starting with a single '/' and not '//', an attacker can construct an Open Redirect link (e.g. https://tabijiapp.com/official?next=https://attacker.com) stealing session context or phishing users.

If the official showcase or terms pages lack explicit framing guards or allow unrestricted iframe embedding, an attacker can embed tabijiapp.com/official in an invisible iframe to conduct UI redressing or clickjacking attacks against incoming visitors.

If Framer Motion SVG path animations or Spring simulations run continuous unthrottled requestAnimationFrame loops without will-change: transform or trigger layout reflows on high-DPI mobile devices, main thread starvation can degrade performance below 15 FPS or trigger iOS WebKit Jetsam process termination.

If legal terms or privacy policy pages dynamically interpolate search parameters, localized translation keys with unescaped HTML, or use dangerouslySetInnerHTML without DOMPurify, an attacker could achieve reflected or DOM-based XSS.
